_comment: The spokes' GPU nodes as ACM Search (search-v2, the search-search-api GraphQL `search` query for kind=Node) returns them: cluster, name, every node label as one "key=value; key=value" string (NVIDIA GPU Feature Discovery's nvidia.com/* labels, shaped like the dev hub's L4 spokes), and the conditions. The fake derives each cluster's status.gpus from them (bff/internal/fakebackend/gpus.go), as the backend does from Search; managedclusters.json's capacity["nvidia.com/gpu"] matches (GPUs x replicas; MIG devices under the single strategy). site-paris-1: H200, 4 nodes x 8. site-madrid-1: MIG single (A100 3g.20gb, 4 devices). site-ashburn-1: L4 time-sliced x4 on 2 nodes. site-frankfurt-1: two configurations (H100 x4 on 1 node, L40S x2 on 2 nodes, one not Ready). local-cluster (the hub, serving models as a combined cluster): L4, 1 node x 1. site-lisbon-1 is not accepted, so its agent never registered and Search has nothing for it. edge-lyon-2 has GPUs in its capacity but no Search entry (it is detaching), so it shows the count only. Node names are fictional.
